subject: P2 CONTENT GAP: feedback_wrong missing on 26 questions across RP4-RP7
body:
CONTENT GAP: feedback_wrong missing on 21 questions across RP6 and RP7

From: GD (design audit)
To: GR (data owner)
Priority: P2 -- exam.html shows "undefined" or falls back to generic hint

BACKGROUND
exam.html gradeExam() uses feedback_wrong to display a targeted message when Kai misses a question.
If feedback_wrong is absent, the renderer has no tailored coaching for incorrect answers.
Kai gets either silence or a generic "check your work" fallback -- both are MCM voice failures.

RP6 MISSING feedback_wrong (12/15 questions):
- rp6-q1 (W2.b, identify) - rp6-q2 (W2.b, identify) - rp6-q3 (W2.b, identify)
- rp6-q4 (W3.d, exponential) - rp6-q5 (W3.d, exponential) - rp6-q8 (W3.d, exponential)
- rp6-q9 (W3.c, rational) - rp6-q10 (W3.e, extraneous) - rp6-q11 (W3.b, fractional-exp)
- rp6-q12 (W2.c, graph) - rp6-q13 (W2.e, graph) - rp6-q15 (W3.a, word-problem)

RP7 MISSING feedback_correct (2/15 questions):
- rp7-q6 (W3.c, radical) - rp7-q10 (W3.d, exponential)

RP7 MISSING feedback_wrong (9/15 questions):
- rp7-q1 (W2.b, identify) - rp7-q2 (W2.b, identify) - rp7-q3 (W2.b, identify)
- rp7-q4 (W3.d, exponential) - rp7-q7 (W3.d, exponential) - rp7-q8 (W3.c, rational)
- rp7-q11 (W3.b, fractional-exp) - rp7-q12 (W2.c, graph) - rp7-q13 (W2.e, graph)

VOICE SPEC (from .voice-guide.md and .design-system.md)
feedback_correct: max 10 words, emoji, Marcus-voice, celebrates result not effort
  Good: "🔥 Parent and intercepts nailed."
  Bad: "Great job! You got this right! Keep it up!"

feedback_wrong: max 10 words, process pointer, no shame
  Good: "Set f(x)=0. Check both cases for ±."
  Bad: "That's incorrect. Try again."

NOTE: Both graph types (W2.c, W2.e) are graph inputs -- feedback_wrong for graphs could be:
  "Wrong points. Show answer overlay and look at the curve."
  (the answer overlay already renders via d.answerOverlay = true in checkGraphAnswer())
  So feedback_wrong for graph questions is already partially handled by the renderer.
  Still needs the text message for the sidebar/hint area.

ALSO FLAGGED: RP4 missing feedback_wrong on 3 questions (rp4-q?, rp4-q?, rp4-q?)
Run: $q4.questions | Where-Object { -not $_.feedback_wrong } to identify.
RP5 missing feedback_wrong on 2 questions.
RP4 missing feedback_wrong: rp4-q1 (W2.b), rp4-q2 (W2.b), rp4-q10 (W3.e extraneous)
RP5 missing feedback_wrong: rp5-q1 (W2.b), rp5-q2 (W2.b)
Total across RP4-RP7: 26 questions missing feedback content.

MATH ACCURACY NOTE
GD is NOT verifying math here. GR should author all feedback_wrong strings.
GD will verify voice/length compliance after GR adds them.
